def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def file_fact(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return {'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': digest(data),

def git(*args):

def environment():
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('HAMMOND_')}

        env.pop(k, None)
    env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'

result = {'schema_version': 1, 'assignment': 'A34', 'status': 'running',
          'purpose': 'Independent actual main-project SourceLeakageTools installation and relocated execution',
          'started_utc': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
          'commands': [], 'checks': [], 'source': {}, 'observations': {}}

def save():

        entry['facts'] = facts
    result['checks'].append(entry)
    save()

def run(label, argv, *, cwd=FOREIGN, traced=False, expect=0):
    argv = [str(x) for x in argv]

    trace_path = SCRATCH / f'{label}.trace'

        actual = ['/usr/bin/strace', '-f', '-qq', '-e', 'trace=%file',
                  '-o', str(trace_path), '--', *argv]
    start = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run(actual, cwd=cwd, env=environment(), capture_output=True, timeout=45)
    record = {'label': label, 'argv': argv, 'actual_argv': actual, 'cwd': str(cwd),
              'returncode': p.returncode, 'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - start,
              'stdout': p.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace'),
              'stderr': p.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace')}
    if traced:
        raw = trace_path.read_bytes()
        trace = raw.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
        record['file_trace'] = {'sha256': digest(raw), 'bytes': len(raw),
                               'source_path_mentions': trace.count(str(ROOT)),
                               'build_path_mentions': trace.count(str(BUILD)),
                               'text': trace}
    result['commands'].append(record)
    save()
    check(label + '_returncode', p.returncode == expect, {'expected': expect, 'observed': p.returncode})
    if traced:
        check(label + '_no_source_or_build_file_references',
              str(ROOT) not in trace and str(BUILD) not in trace)
    return record

try:
    check('owned_scratch_and_new_outputs', SCRATCH.is_dir() and not PREFIX.exists()
          and not MOVED.exists() and not FOREIGN.exists() and not REPORT.exists())
    FOREIGN.mkdir()
    result['source'] = {'repository': str(ROOT), 'build': str(BUILD),
                        'head': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'head_tree': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'),

                        'expected_published_base': EXPECTED_BASE,

                        'root_cmake_patch': git('diff', '--', 'CMakeLists.txt')}
    check('published_base_present', git('rev-parse', EXPECTED_BASE + '^{tree}') == result['source']['head_tree'])
    payload = {
        Path('bin/hammond_render'): BUILD / 'hammond_render',
        Path('bin/hammond_source_leakage_probe'): BUILD / 'hammond_source_leakage_probe',
        Path('bin/hammond_source_leakage_benchmark'): BUILD / 'hammond_source_leakage_benchmark',
        PACKAGE / 'profiles/nominal.b3p': BUILD / 'nominal.b3p',
        **{PACKAGE / p: ROOT / p for p in ('tools/compile_source_leakage.py',
              'data/source-leakage.schema.json', 'data/source-leakage/synthetic-pair-demo-v1.json',
              'data/source-leakage/synthetic-identity-v1.json', 'docs/SOURCE_LEAKAGE_INSTALL.md')},
    }
    read_only = list(payload.values()) + [ROOT / p for p in ('CMakeLists.txt',
                'cmake/InstallHammondTools.cmake', 'cmake/InstallSourceLeakageTools.cmake',
                'tests/test_source_leakage_install.py', 'docs/SOURCE_LEAKAGE_CONTRACT.md',
                'docs/SOURCE_LEAKAGE_AUDITION_CONTRACT.md')]
    read_only += [BUILD / p for p in ('CMakeCache.txt', 'build.ninja', 'cmake_install.cmake',
                                    'CMakeFiles/rules.ninja', 'libhammond_core.a')]
    before = {str(p): file_fact(p) for p in read_only}
    result['source']['read_only_input_identities'] = before
    production_paths = git('ls-files', 'include/hammond', 'src', 'tools/render.cpp',

                           'tools/compile_source_leakage.py').splitlines()
    production = {}
    for p in production_paths:
        data = (ROOT / p).read_bytes()
        committed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', EXPECTED_BASE + ':' + p], cwd=ROOT)
        production[p] = {'sha256': digest(data), 'matches_base': data == committed}
    result['source']['runtime_production_inputs'] = production
    check('runtime_production_inputs_match_published_base', all(p['matches_base'] for p in production.values()),
          {'count': len(production)})
    manifest = BUILD / 'install_manifest_SourceLeakageTools.txt'
    result['observations']['prior_component_manifest_exists'] = manifest.exists()
    if manifest.exists():

    result['environment'] = {'platform': platform.platform(), 'python': sys.version,
                             'python_executable': sys.executable,

    result['environment']['cmake_version'] = run('cmake_version', [CMAKE, '--version'])['stdout']
    result['environment']['cxx_version'] = run('cxx_version', ['/usr/bin/c++', '--version'])['stdout']
    cache = (BUILD / 'CMakeCache.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    keys = {'CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE', 'CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER', 'CMAKE_C_COMPILER', 'CMAKE_GENERATOR',

    for relative, original in payload.items():

        result['installed_inventory'][relative.as_posix()] = {**facts, 'original_path': str(original),

    manifest_raw = manifest.read_bytes()
    manifest_paths = manifest_raw.decode().splitlines()
    check('actual_project_component_manifest_exact', set(manifest_paths) == {str(PREFIX / p) for p in payload})
    result['observations']['generated_component_manifest'] = {'path': str(manifest),

    PREFIX.rename(MOVED)

    package = MOVED / PACKAGE
    # Wrong data in the unrelated CWD catches implicit relative defaults.
    (FOREIGN / 'nominal.b3p').write_bytes(b'wrong cwd profile\n')
    (FOREIGN / 'synthetic-pair-demo-v1.json').write_bytes(b'{"wrong":"cwd"}\n')
    graph_receipts = {}
    for name, count in (('pair', 2), ('identity', 0)):
        author = package / 'data/source-leakage' / (
            'synthetic-pair-demo-v1.json' if count else 'synthetic-identity-v1.json')
        record = run('compile_' + name, [sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-S',
                    package / 'tools/compile_source_leakage.py', '--input', author,
                    '--output', name + '.b3leakage'], traced=True)
        receipt = json.loads(record['stdout'])
        check('compiler_' + name + '_byte_provenance', receipt['input_sha256'] == digest(author.read_bytes())

        facts = json.loads(probe['stdout'])

        expected_input = [(i - 45) / 64 for i in range(91)]

            expected_output[edge['destination'] - 1] += edge['gain'] * expected_input[edge['source'] - 1]
        check('probe_' + name + '_exact_fixture_algebra', facts['edges'] == expected_edges

    outputs = {}
    common = ['--profile', package / 'profiles/nominal.b3p', '--frames', '96000',

              '--drawbars', '008000000', '--note', '48', '--contacts', 'ideal',
              '--percussion', 'off', '--fail-on-clip']
    for name, graph, gain in (('pair', 'pair', '0.75'), ('identity', 'identity', '0.75'),
                             ('default', None, None), ('identity_unity', 'identity', '1')):
        args = [MOVED / 'bin/hammond_render', *common, '--output', name + '.wav']
        if graph:
            args += ['--source-leakage', graph + '.b3leakage', '--leakage-input-gain', gain]
        record = run('render_' + name, args, traced=True)
        facts = json.loads(record['stdout'])
        check('render_' + name + '_successful_unclipped', facts['status'] == 'ok'
              and facts['clipped_channel_samples'] == 0 and facts['peak'] > 0
              and facts['render_schema_version'] == (5 if graph else 3))
        if graph:
            check('render_' + name + '_explicit_graph_facts',
                  facts['source_leakage_input_gain'] == float(gain)
                  and facts['source_leakage_edge_count'] == (2 if graph == 'pair' else 0)
                  and facts['source_leakage_authoring_sha256'] == graph_receipts[graph]['input_sha256']
                  and facts['source_leakage_guarded_output_bound'] <= 1

        output = FOREIGN / (name + '.wav')
        with wave.open(str(output), 'rb') as wav:

        check('render_' + name + '_pcm_shape', shape == [2, 2, 48000, 96000])
        samples = array.array('h', pcm)
        if sys.byteorder != 'little':
            samples.byteswap()
        check('render_' + name + '_dry_stereo_equality', samples[0::2] == samples[1::2])
        outputs[name] = {'bytes': output.read_bytes(), 'samples': samples,
                         'facts': {**file_fact(output), 'shape': shape}}
    changed = [abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(outputs['pair']['samples'][0::2], outputs['identity']['samples'][0::2])]
    check('same_gain_pair_changes_audio', any(changed),

    check('legacy_and_explicit_unity_identity_byte_exact', outputs['default']['bytes'] == outputs['identity_unity']['bytes'])
    result['audio_outputs'] = {name: item['facts'] for name, item in outputs.items()}
    benchmark = run('installed_benchmark', [MOVED / 'bin/hammond_source_leakage_benchmark',

    facts = json.loads(benchmark['stdout'])
    check('benchmark_functional_nineteen_cases', facts['sanity_passed'] and len(facts['rows']) == 19
          and not facts['callback_deadlines_measured'])
    for name in ('hammond_render', 'hammond_source_leakage_probe', 'hammond_source_leakage_benchmark'):
        dynamic = run('dynamic_' + name, ['/usr/bin/readelf', '-d', MOVED / 'bin' / name])
        check('no_runtime_search_path_' + name, 'RPATH' not in dynamic['stdout'] and 'RUNPATH' not in dynamic['stdout'])
    installed_after = {p.relative_to(MOVED).as_posix(): file_fact(p)

    check('installed_package_unchanged_after_runtime', installed_before == installed_after)
    after = {str(p): file_fact(p) for p in read_only}
    check('all_read_only_inputs_unchanged', before == after, {'count': len(before)})

    result['observations']['traced_runtime_processes'] = sum('file_trace' in x for x in result['commands'])
    result['observations']['total_runtime_trace_bytes'] = sum(x.get('file_trace', {}).get('bytes', 0) for x in result['commands'])
    result['observations']['source_build_dependence_scope'] = (
        'Source/build remained present and read-only; strace file-system traces for all nine actual runtime commands contain zero original source/build path references. '
        'No repository/build isolation, physical device, performance threshold or platform other than this Linux Release is claimed.')
    result['observations']['scratch_peak_retained_file_bytes'] = sum(p.stat().st_size for p in SCRATCH.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
    check('scratch_under_three_mib', result['observations']['scratch_peak_retained_file_bytes'] < 3 * 1024 * 1024)
    result['status'] = 'passed'
except Exception as error:
    result['status'] = 'failed'
    result['error'] = {'type': type(error).__name__, 'message': str(error)}
    raise
finally:
    result['finished_utc'] = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())
    result['script_sha256'] = digest(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
    save()
    print(json.dumps({'status': result['status'], 'checks': len(result['checks']),

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Continue A34 after an unavailable optional syscall tracer; preserve attempt."""
from pathlib import Path
import array
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import wave

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/7802a6528f89/Hammond-B3-Organ')
SCRATCH = ROOT.parent / 'a34-install'
MOVED = SCRATCH / 'Moved Source Leakage Tools-é音'
FOREIGN = SCRATCH / 'unrelated working directory'
OUT = FOREIGN / 'leakage audition'
PACKAGE = MOVED / 'share/hammond-b3-organ/source-leakage'
REPORT = ROOT / 'docs/development/2026-11-15-audio-continuation/reports/A34-real-install.json'
first_raw = (SCRATCH / 'first-attempt-original.json').read_bytes()
first = json.loads(first_raw)

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def fact(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return {'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': sha(data), 'mode': f'{stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode):04o}'}

result = {'schema_version': 1, 'assignment': 'A34', 'status': 'running',
          'purpose': first['purpose'], 'source': first['source'],
          'environment': first['environment'], 'installed_inventory': first['installed_inventory'],
          'initial_observations': first['observations'],
          'read_only_input_identities_after_actual_install': json.loads((SCRATCH / 'post-install-read-only.json').read_text()),
          'original_attempts': [{'classification': 'Optional tracing setup blocked before product execution',
               'report_sha256': sha(first_raw), 'report_bytes': len(first_raw),
               'report_json_utf8_base64': base64.b64encode(first_raw).decode(),
               'reason': 'strace PTRACE_TRACEME and PTRACE_SETOPTIONS returned Operation not permitted',
               'product_command_executed': False,
               'scope': 'Only the compile_pair tracing attempt failed; actual install/inventory/relocation checks had passed.'}],
          'initial_successful_commands': first['commands'][:-1],
          'initial_passed_checks': [x for x in first['checks'] if x['passed']],
          'commands': [], 'checks': [], 'limitations': [
               'Linux x86-64 GCC 14.2 Release only; Windows/PowerShell inspected but not executed.',
               'Source/build remain present and read-only; runtime uses only installed and output paths, but syscall tracing and filesystem isolation are unqualified.',
               'SourceLeakageTools preflight is not transactional against concurrent filesystem writers or later I/O failures.',
               'Functional benchmark invocation carries no timing, callback deadline, stack or physical-fidelity acceptance.',
               'No primary configure/build or production modification; CMake generated its normal component install manifest.']}

def save():
    REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')

def check(name, passed, facts=None):
    item = {'check': name, 'passed': bool(passed)}
    if facts is not None:
        item['facts'] = facts
    result['checks'].append(item)
    save()
    if not passed:
        raise AssertionError(name)

def run(label, argv, cwd):
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('HAMMOND_')}
    for name in ('PYTHONHOME', 'PYTHONPATH', 'DESTDIR', 'CMAKE_INSTALL_MODE'):
        env.pop(name, None)
    env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
    command = list(map(str, argv))
    start = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=45)
    record = {'label': label, 'argv': command, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'returncode': p.returncode,
              'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - start,
              'stdout': p.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace'), 'stderr': p.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace')}
    result['commands'].append(record)
    check(label + '_returncode', p.returncode == 0)
    return record

try:
    check('first_failure_preserved_exactly', first['error']['message'] == 'compile_pair_returncode'
          and first['commands'][-1]['stdout'] == '' and not (FOREIGN / 'pair.b3leakage').exists())
    check('relocated_runtime_outputs_are_new', not OUT.exists())
    installed_before = {p.relative_to(MOVED).as_posix(): fact(p) for p in MOVED.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    check('installed_inventory_still_exact', len(installed_before) == 9
          and all(installed_before[k] == {q: v for q, v in item.items() if q in ('bytes', 'sha256', 'mode')}
                  for k, item in result['installed_inventory'].items()))
    guide = (PACKAGE / 'docs/SOURCE_LEAKAGE_INSTALL.md').read_text()
    marker = 'leakage_prefix="/absolute/path/Source Leakage Tools"'
    posix = guide.split('```sh\n', 2)[2].split('\n```', 1)[0]
    check('exact_posix_guide_block_selected', posix.startswith(marker)
          and '--output identity.wav' in posix and '--frames 96000' in posix)
    posix = posix.replace(marker, 'leakage_prefix=$1', 1)
    # Only substitute the user's chosen prefix. The operating block is otherwise literal.
    record = run('literal_installed_posix_guide', ['/bin/sh', '-eu', '-c', posix,
                 'source-leakage-install-guide', MOVED], FOREIGN)
    lines = [json.loads(x) for x in record['stdout'].splitlines() if x.strip()]
    check('guide_emitted_five_tool_receipts', len(lines) == 5)
    compile_pair, compile_identity, pair_probe, pair_render, identity_render = lines
    graph_receipts = {'pair': compile_pair, 'identity': compile_identity}
    for name, filename, count in [('pair', 'synthetic-pair-demo-v1.json', 2),
                                  ('identity', 'synthetic-identity-v1.json', 0)]:
        receipt = graph_receipts[name]
        author = PACKAGE / 'data/source-leakage' / filename
        compiled = OUT / (name + '.b3leakage')
        check('compiler_' + name + '_exact_byte_provenance', receipt['input_sha256'] == sha(author.read_bytes())
              and receipt['compiled_sha256'] == sha(compiled.read_bytes()) and receipt['edge_count'] == count
              and receipt['evidence_status'] == 'synthetic')
    record = run('installed_identity_probe', [MOVED / 'bin/hammond_source_leakage_probe',
                                            '--input', 'identity.b3leakage'], OUT)
    identity_probe = json.loads(record['stdout'])
    expected_input = [((((i + 1) * 37) % 129) - 64) / 64 for i in range(91)]
    for name, facts in [('pair', pair_probe), ('identity', identity_probe)]:
        edges = ([{'destination': 25, 'source': 37, 'gain': 0.0625},
                  {'destination': 37, 'source': 25, 'gain': -0.03125}] if name == 'pair' else [])
        expected = expected_input.copy()
        for edge in edges:
            expected[edge['destination'] - 1] += edge['gain'] * expected_input[edge['source'] - 1]
        check('probe_' + name + '_exact_published_fixture', facts['edges'] == edges
              and facts['input_frame'] == expected_input and facts['output_frame'] == expected
              and facts['authoring_sha256'] == graph_receipts[name]['input_sha256']
              and facts['authoring_digest_verification'] == 'file-supplied-unverified')
    renders = {'pair': pair_render, 'identity': identity_render}
    for name, selected in [('default', False), ('identity_unity', True)]:
        args = [MOVED / 'bin/hammond_render', '--profile', PACKAGE / 'profiles/nominal.b3p',
                '--output', name + '.wav', '--frames', '96000', '--sample-rate', '48000',
                '--block-size', '64', '--seed', '1939', '--drawbars', '008000000',
                '--note', '48', '--contacts', 'ideal', '--percussion', 'off', '--fail-on-clip']
        if selected:
            args += ['--source-leakage', 'identity.b3leakage', '--leakage-input-gain', '1']
        renders[name] = json.loads(run('installed_render_' + name, args, OUT)['stdout'])
    audio = {}
    for name, facts in renders.items():
        selected = name != 'default'
        graph = 'pair' if name == 'pair' else 'identity'
        check('render_' + name + '_unclipped_and_schema', facts['status'] == 'ok'
              and facts['clipped_channel_samples'] == 0 and facts['peak'] > 0
              and facts['render_schema_version'] == (5 if selected else 3))
        if selected:
            gain = 1 if name == 'identity_unity' else 0.75
            check('render_' + name + '_explicit_facts', facts['source_leakage_input_gain'] == gain
                  and facts['source_leakage_edge_count'] == (2 if graph == 'pair' else 0)
                  and facts['source_leakage_authoring_sha256'] == graph_receipts[graph]['input_sha256']
                  and facts['source_leakage_guarded_output_bound'] <= 1
                  and facts['source_leakage_identity_bypass'] == (name == 'identity_unity'))
        path = OUT / (name + '.wav')
        with wave.open(str(path), 'rb') as wav:
            shape = [wav.getnchannels(), wav.getsampwidth(), wav.getframerate(), wav.getnframes()]
            pcm = wav.readframes(wav.getnframes())
        check('render_' + name + '_pcm_shape', shape == [2, 2, 48000, 96000])
        samples = array.array('h', pcm)
        if sys.byteorder != 'little':
            samples.byteswap()
        check('render_' + name + '_dry_stereo', samples[0::2] == samples[1::2])
        audio[name] = {'bytes': path.read_bytes(), 'samples': samples,
                       'facts': {**fact(path), 'shape': shape}}
